verdict.rationale: Omnara docs confirm you can attach images and documents to a conversation with an agent, which supports the general idea of sharing a screenshot/mockup as task input. However, there is no evidence of markup/annotation tooling, or of the agent specifically interpreting marked-up visual diffs to implement a targeted visual change — missing for 10: annotation/markup tooling, evidence of visual-diff interpretation, and any UI-specific workflow around attaching mockups to a task.
